phases.title: Contracts, tooling, and feasibility
Minimal production-shaped screen slice
Settings parity port behind runtime flag (old Settings stays default; never deleted by the autonomous build)
First production pilot (card management vs garage, selected by rubric)
Director Part-2 workstreams: Table Phase B, Edit-mode preview harness, BillboardTarget, first game Table surface
Hardening: fuzzing, fault injection, virtualization/navigation/a11y-l10n, perf runner, semver, error boundaries, engine styling, agentic maintainability, documentation

Input auto-adaptation audit + closure: every control ships focus/navigation, Activate, and input-appropriate affordances for pointer, touch, keyboard, and gamepad with no consumer wiring (ui_todo §0 held automatically; §3 engine truths encoded)
Phase-5 expansion: UI.TextInput — signal-backed value model + engine TextBox adapter with capability detection, text-entry-mode handshake, occlusion keep-visible; examples 01/02 upgraded
Interaction-paradigm expansion: three adaptation axes (UI/input/paradigm), hybrid + hot-switch, console 10-foot

Roblox-native substrate adoption (roadmap Step 1): corrected native capability matrix with evidence; ScrollingFrame scroll/clip host, UIDragDetector, native touch events, Path2D, UIPageLayout decision, four-edge safe areas, single-application preferred text, modal-only selection bridge, PreloadAsync transport — deterministic decisions stay headless

Roblox-native StyleSheets as the runtime styling source of truth (roadmap Step 2): DataModel sheet + Style Editor own every proven styleable paint property, semantic role, native interaction state, app-state tag, theme, and transition; state-as-tags, one authority per property with explicit-write fallback as a separate target mode; layout solver inputs stay headless Luau
Trustworthy authoring, then adaptive layout and the common controls (roadmap Step 3)

Public versioned theme packages, metric-aware swapping, and bounded rich skinning (roadmap Step 3.5): one ThemePackage contract around native StyleSheets, one frozen metric snapshot shared by solver and adapter, font-aware measurement, an honest Style Editor sync workflow, bounded chrome recipes/decoration slots, and Fantasy Parchment as the public-API proof theme

Rich skinning v2 — fully image-driven UI (director direction from the Step 3.5 TP-P3 review): image-is-the-element posture, layered decoration slots, per-state asset variants at both customization rungs, image value-displays, semantic icons, pixel-art mode, Content adoption, profile-conditional selectBy package selection, the tile decision, toggle slots, and the SwiftUI customization ladder — consuming the ADR-0019 contract, never reopening it
Cross-platform performance proof and the future spatial seam: production-shaped scenes, evidence-class separation, the reusable Studio five-view driver, and spatial contracts with no VR claim

Sponsor-required framework capability: interruptible motion authority, structural transitions, toast presentation, unified virtualized collection, public drag/drop with edge autoscroll, paint/layer/marker extensions, semantic feedback events, async-avatar completeness, billboard fixture — proven in a Sponsor-shaped gallery with no game policy in Facet

Fresh-context simplicity cleanup (roadmap Step 5.5): a behaviour-preserving audit that deletes proved waste, consolidates duplicated decisions at one owner, and dispositions every Step 5 carry-over — with unchanged public API, deprecations, property authority, theme/Sponsor mechanisms, Studio behaviour, lifecycle/resource counts, and headless performance

API and architecture constitution (roadmap Step 7): one example-backed rule set governing the whole public surface; complete surface ledger with every public item classified as a named pattern or justified exception; compatible fixes and ADR-0011 deprecations only; agent-friendly enforcement checks and a fresh-author exercise through the canonical extension path

Desktop keyboard focus-chain behavior (roadmap Step 8): Tab/Shift+Tab traversal of the existing focus graph, Space alongside Return as Activate, and focused-value-control arrow Adjust — bound through the Input Action System only while an interactive responder owns UI input and keyboard capability is live, with passive HUD and gameplay input untouched

Tab traverses in document order, and the focus chain is inspectable (roadmap Step 8 follow-up): a focusable Grip stops being deferred to the end of the LINEAR order while the directional arrows keep the deferral unchanged; one focus map read two ways via a presenter-supplied rank; a new public `traversalPriority` sort tier and a `handle.focusOrder()` inspection dump

The player's PreferredTextSize as a first-class layout input (roadmap Step 8.5): measured per-preference offsets applied exactly once and live-updating without remount; the reflow -> scroll -> bounded-truncation-with-full-value-access overflow order across the public surface; text/overlap/hit-floor/focus-visibility diagnostics; the Rascal Rally Sponsor View proved at all four values on compact mobile portrait and landscape

Publish-ready Facet performance stress place and repeatable profiling loop (roadmap Step 9): a self-contained examples/places/Facet-PerformanceLab.rbxl that opens without Rojo, a deterministic scenario registry centred on a dense interactive virtualized list with a matched raw-Roblox reference, flat-versus-ornate theme cost, large-text/long-content reflow, bounded virtualization, low-cardinality MicroProfiler phase scopes, safe ramp/emergency stop, clean-capture mode and idle teardown — with Lune, Studio, emulator and physical Android evidence kept separately labelled

Tutorial gallery quality pass (roadmap Step 10): all seven tutorial examples understandable and playable in Studio WITHOUT reading their source — one designed Facet product sharing the native-StyleSheet property authority, adapting across the canonical five views and the supported input paradigms, with deterministic reset paths, a complete Wordle-like word game, a visibly taught optimistic-sync lesson, played-and-corrected tile and match-3 games, an ownership ledger proving examples hold domain/content plus declarative composition while reusable fixes live behind public Facet APIs, and standalone places that rebuild
Clean-room reference-app proofs (Apple Backyard Birds / Food Truck / Fruta + Roblox app home & avatar editor) with honest feature ledgers

SwiftUI-parity row swipe actions: newRowActions/newRowActionsCoordinator + Table rowActions, full cross-input coverage (touch/mouse/keyboard/gamepad/edit-mode), with the perf gate re-baselined to Task 11b's measured mount-dominated numbers (director ruling 2026-08-11) and the closure path tracked as a follow-up mission

SwiftUI parity round 2: presenter.withAnimation at the presentation layer, the everyday layout vocabulary (distribute, layoutPriority x shrinkWeight, lineAlign, GridRow + gridSpan, containerRelativeFrame, VirtualList axis), indeterminate indicators + Spinner, UI.sensoryFeedback over the semantic bus with a default-off haptics adapter, Table onPrimaryAction across four inputs, every round-2 API reachable in a gallery scenario the suite executes headlessly, the parity doc rewritten as one cited falsifiable draft, and a fast test tier - registered AFTER the mission closed, which is itself the finding: M1/M2/M3 all ran with no stage for tools/gate.sh to run

Declarative 3D architecture decision: whether and how the studio builds a declarative fine-grained-reactive system for Roblox Parts/Models - a reviewed plain-language ADR (Facet extension vs sibling-with-shared-kernel vs independent system vs no build) backed by an isolated disproof spike with topology, lifecycle, and cost evidence. PASS means the decision is proved, not that Facet supports 3D; the stage merges nothing into Facet, extracts no core, and starts no production package

SwiftUI parity round 3: flow-wrap as a native arrange branch (`wrap` on HStack/VStack, the hwrap/vwrap solver kinds, the first cross-axis overflow diagnostic in the repo); the custom `Layout` protocol evaluated and recorded as a conditional refusal with a named trigger; per-row capability opt-outs (rowSelectable/rowMovable/rowDeletable) gated at the funnel across Table and newVirtualList; circular progress in BOTH forms on Path2D; the five clean-room reference apps re-proved against the new vocabulary; the completeness audit's ranked gaps (onAppear/onDisappear/hidden) plus the four capabilities that already shipped and were never rowed; the showcase chrome restructured so keyboard and gamepad reach it AND the demo, with the reduced-motion settings surface it unblocked; an accessibility-text-size axis on the always-on sweeps; the lying-itemExtent guard; and one viewport change coalesced from five solves to one - registered after the fact, as round 2 was, and with every device claim carried as an explicit PENDING row rather than asserted

phases.title: SwiftUI parity round 4: two-dimensional focus (ADR-0030), time-based easing (ADR-0033), the foreign-instance seam (ADR-0034), preferred transparency (ADR-0035), the hit-expander z rule, UI.When's branch scope, UI.sortedEntries, the tint-fill tag, the zstack hugging-margin fix, the native-scroll auto-bind, appChromeRects and the screen gutter, and the two framework comparison documents
phases.specSection: docs/adr/ADR-0030, ADR-0033, ADR-0034, ADR-0035; registered after the fact 2026-08-16

phases.title: Navigation & transient menus: the sweep economy (one suite run per sweep instead of 234, plus a checker that replays every manifest grep against a live transcript), the anchored-surface seam, the Menu construct with submenus, help and Callout as two constructs rather than one, the sliding selection indicator, TabView (nestable, lazy, evicted), segmented-picker icons and a real vertical pill, the HUD repair where elision must DISCLOSE rather than delete, and the playlist table's sort + resize retiring the standalone table_columns scenario

Release-candidate review, the LuauUI-to-Facet rename, and remediation (roadmap Step 13): freeze baselines, rename the framework and both Rascal Rally projects to Facet with history-preserving moves and a dual-read attribute migration, whole-framework fresh-context review with a severity/confidence finding ledger, Input Action System as the one semantic input authority, original press/release/select haptic defaults behind the game-opt-in adapter, rebuilt guide/API catalogs with product-language and clear-writing scans, the ELI5 new-control path proven by disposable fresh-agent exercises, one naming ADR with compatible migration, performance requalification on the refreshed lab, and the Step 14 remote-change packet prepared without mutating the remote
